prompt: just explain what a mortgage is in one paragraph
text: A mortgage is a long-term loan specifically used to purchase or maintain real estate, where the property itself serves as collateral to secure the debt. The borrower agrees to repay the lender—typically a bank—the principal amount plus interest over a set period, often 15 or 30 years, through regular monthly installments. While the borrower has the right to live in and use the home, the lender maintains a legal interest in the title; if the borrower fails to meet the repayment terms, the lender has the right to seize the property through a legal process known as foreclosure to recover the remaining balance of the loan.
